2608.04570.title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads
2608.04570.paper_summary: Personalized LLMs with persistent memory are increasingly deployed, yet the faithfulness of their user models remains unexamined. We study over-inference (OI): the phenomenon where LLMs fabricate user attributes beyond what evidence supports. We introduce MirageBench, comprising 150 personas balanced across stereotypical, counter-stereotypical, and neutral profiles, 6 personalization tasks spanning an ``imagination gradient'', a four-way faithfulness taxonomy operationalized by an independent judge (validated against a blind human annotator on 400 claims: Cohen's kappa = 0.863 four-class, kappa = 0.900 binary), and a leaderboard of 12 models across 7 families on 143616 judged claims. We find that over-inference is pervasive: every one of the 12 models over-infers 35%--49% of its claims (cross-model mean 41.6%; claim-weighted 41.8%), with no model in this evaluation escaping it. Most strikingly, we surface a Self-Monitoring Inversion: at the model-selection level, models' self-assessed OI is negatively rank-correlated with their judge-measured OI (rho = -0.60, p = 0.044; exploratory, wide bootstrap CI [-0.90, +0.06], n = 12). The models that report the least over-inference tend to be flagged as fabricating the most, so self-reported confidence is a misleading signal for comparing models, even though within a single model self-audit still ranks that model's own claims moderately well (AUROC 0.58--0.83). We further show that OI is task-dependent (27%--59%) and that, in a multi-turn pilot, inferred attributes accumulate approximately linearly with little revision. MirageBench positions external verification, rather than model self-report, as a more reliable foundation for trustworthy personalization.
2608.04570.paper_summary_zh: 個性化的 LLM 伴隨持久記憶的部署日益增多，但其用戶模型的可信度仍然未經檢驗。我們研究了過度推斷（OI）：這是一種現象，LLM 製造出超出證據支持的用戶屬性。我們引入了 MirageBench，包含 150 個角色，這些角色在刻板印象、反刻板印象和中立形象之間保持平衡，6 個個性化任務跨越“想像梯度”，一個由獨立評審操作化的四維可信度分類法（與 400 條聲明的盲人註釋者進行驗證：Cohen's kappa = 0.863 四類，kappa = 0.900 二類），以及 12 個模型在 7 個家族中的排行榜，涵蓋 143616 條經評判的聲明。我們發現過度推斷是普遍存在的：這 12 個模型中的每一個都過度推斷了 35%--49% 的聲明（跨模型平均 41.6%；聲明加權 41.8%），在這次評估中沒有模型逃脫此現象。最引人注目的是，我們發現了一個自我監控反轉：在模型選擇層面，模型自評的 OI 與其評審測量的 OI 之間存在負相關（rho = -0.60，p = 0.044；探索性，廣泛自助法 CI [-0.90, +0.06]，n = 12）。報告最少過度推斷的模型往往被標記為製造最多的，因此自我報告的信心對於比較模型來說是一個誤導性信號，儘管在單一模型內部，自我審核仍然能夠將該模型自己的聲明中等程度地排名（AUROC 0.58--0.83）。我們進一步顯示 OI 是任務依賴的（27%--59%），並且在一個多輪試點中，推斷的屬性大約以線性方式累積，幾乎沒有修正。MirageBench 將外部驗證定位為比模型自報更可靠的可信個性化基礎。
